narrative.overview: Warm surfaces, compact typography, continuous working areas and restrained elevation. This source-derived foundation record covers shared chrome, the paginated editor explorer and registry presentation. Existing endpoint tabs remain; the complete feature-workspace migration is future work.
keyCharacteristics: System UI and local mono typography
Existing feature and mutation contracts retained

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Change light and dark mappings together, using existing semantic CSS roles.

rules.name: The Continuous Surface Rule
rules.body: Registry rows touch and share borders; workbench cards/buttons do not gain decorative elevation or hover translation.

dos: Do retain full endpoint identities and accessible names.
Do keep unchecked migrations visibly future work.
Do keep the visible footer Shortcuts opener available after single-key opt-out.
donts: Do not present Editor / Callback / Settings or split request/response panes as shipped.
Do not store configuration drafts or secrets in workbench preferences.
Do not alter matching, import, mutation or run-isolation behavior as a visual side effect.
